data.one_liner: build_runner integration for slang translation generation
data.what_it_does: Integrates the slang translation library into the standard Dart build_runner pipeline. It enables developers to generate type-safe localization files alongside other code generation tools. Configuration is handled through build.yaml instead of slang.yaml.
use_when: You use slang for translations and already use build_runner for other code generators
You want a unified single-command build step for all project code generation
avoid_when: You do not use build_runner and prefer slang's standalone CLI tool
You are not using slang for localization
strengths: Combines translation generation into existing build_runner pipelines
Includes a legacy fallback builder if build_runner asset writer issues occur
weaknesses: The default builder has known issues with asset writing in some build configurations
The legacy builder does not support build_runner build --workspace
data.setup_notes: Requires dev_dependencies on build_runner and slang_build_runner, configuration in build.yaml, and running build_runner build.
data.minimal_example:
targets:
  $default:
    builders:
      slang_build_runner:
        options:
          base_locale: en
